scope: Anonymous session bootstrap and the single POST /api/plan/draft handoff.
testModeReason: The card changes anonymous session, ownership, and the public draft boundary. No verified affected-test selector exists.

engineeringRegression.dedicatedCardCommand: npm run test -- api/plan-draft api/plan-draft-guardrails api/plan-draft-e2e
engineeringRegression.discovery: vitest file filter; the dedicated command covers the seven fixed scenarios

cases.command: npm run test -- api/plan-draft api/plan-draft-guardrails api/plan-draft-e2e
cases.expected: Anonymous bootstrap sets only a signed cookie and writes no business rows.

cases.command: npm run test -- api/plan-draft api/plan-draft-guardrails api/plan-draft-e2e
cases.expected: A draft without a valid cookie returns 401 BOOTSTRAP_ANONYMOUS_SESSION and writes nothing.

cases.command: npm run test -- api/plan-draft api/plan-draft-guardrails api/plan-draft-e2e
cases.expected: One transaction creates a DRAFT record, PLAN_DRAFT command, idempotency row, and USER message; blocking gaps finish NEEDS_INFO and COMPLETED with no PlannerRun.

cases.command: npm run test -- api/plan-draft api/plan-draft-guardrails api/plan-draft-e2e
cases.expected: Precise mode with missing facts returns NEEDS_INFORMATION and does not write a formal plan version.

cases.command: npm run test -- api/plan-draft api/plan-draft-guardrails api/plan-draft-e2e
cases.expected: The same key and payload replays the original ids with replayed true and zero new writes.

cases.command: npm run test -- api/plan-draft api/plan-draft-guardrails api/plan-draft-e2e
cases.expected: The same key with a different payload returns 409 IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED and writes nothing.

cases.command: npm run test -- api/plan-draft api/plan-draft-guardrails api/plan-draft-e2e
cases.expected: Timeout, invalid JSON, cost, and the sixth quota request fail the command as FAILED. Quota rejection does not call the provider.
